implementation: Detached SSR parsing (no executable iframe). Dedicated pinned Socket.IO2/EIO3 client authenticates without enqueueing. Explicit start_game_search follows proven disbandment/readiness. Server ACK and game-found are separate outcomes; ordinary page recovery uses bounded, authorized site methods without DOM clicks.

siteEvidence.recovery: checkIfUserInSearch calls /api/search/me; disconnected search starts a new connection. session_initialized with own timeInSearch restores state without another start_game_search. This demonstrates the intended client recovery path, not a live proof of unchanged server priority.

comparison.kind: deterministic shared-server replay: dedicated DirectSearch protocol versus actual downloaded site methods; assumed timings are not live game latency
